# Hershey Script Simplex

Source: https://github.com/kamalmostafa/hershey-fonts, commit
1356bf2f83d380fcef68c887e88675eb9d445d86, `hershey-fonts/scripts.jhf`,
unmodified (the data originally from
http://emergent.unpythonic.net/software/hershey).

The Hershey Fonts were originally created by Dr. A. V. Hershey while working
at the U. S. National Bureau of Standards. The format of the Font data in this
distribution was originally created by James Hurt, Cognition, Inc., 900
Technology Park Drive, Billerica, MA 01821. The full use terms are in
LICENSE.txt. The gallery's "aloha" lettering is built from the glyph records
for a, l, o and h in this file.
